metadata.title: Quantum field theory and four-manifolds: Perspectives from physics and geometry
metadata.abstract: These lecture notes are based on lecture series by the authors for the Summer School 2025 on ``Physical mathematics of quantum field theory" at the University of Massachusetts Amherst organized by Owen Gwilliam, Chris Elliott, and Matteo Lotito. The lectures centred around algebraic structures arising from twists of supersymmetric quantum field theories, correlation functions of topologically twisted supersymmetric gauge theories, and their mathematical counterparts as intersection-theoretic invariants associated to moduli spaces of instantons, semistable sheaves, or Higgs sheaves on four-manifolds or complex projective surfaces.

analysis.workSummary: 整理超对称量子场论扭曲产生的代数结构、拓扑规范理论关联函数及四维流形模空间不变量。
techniques: 瞬子与半稳定层模空间
analysis.breakthrough: 以 2025 年暑期学校讲义连接物理构造与瞬子、层和 Higgs 层模空间的数学语言。
analysis.limitations: 属于长篇教学综述，摘要未标示一个可单独归属本文的新主定理；不应将综述中的既有结果全部算作新突破。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
